headline: US plans to livestream firing squad execution
standfirst: Defense officials confirm the upcoming execution of the Fort Hood shooter will be

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: Defense officials confirmed the execution of Nidal Hasan will be livestreamed to the public.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: Hasan was a US Army major convicted of killing 13 people at the Texas military base.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: It marks a rare public broadcast of a capital punishment case by the US military.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Look for official confirmation on the timing of this planned event from the Defense Department.

caption:
The US government plans to livestream the execution of the Fort Hood shooter.

Nidal Hasan, a former major in the US Army, was convicted for his role in the 2009 mass shooting at a Texas military base. Defense Department officials confirmed the planned broadcast to news outlets this week.
